model_variants.label: Naive Baseline
model_variants.description: National average demand scaled to Lucknow population

model_variants.label: Original Analog
model_variants.description: Direct transfer from analog cities — uncalibrated, no store format weighting

model_variants.label: Fix 1: Store Type
model_variants.description: Analog transfer weighted by store format (Express / Dark Store / Hypermarket)

model_variants.label: Fix 2: Blending
model_variants.description: Bayesian blend: analog prior decays as live Lucknow data grows (day_alpha = d/90)

model_variants.label: Fix 3: Festival
model_variants.description: Festival calendar uplift from analog city patterns — applied on top of analog

model_variants.label: All 3 Combined
model_variants.description: Store type + Bayesian blending + festival — combined but Fix 2 alone wins

methodology.algorithm: Bayesian analog blending with store-format calibration and festival uplift
methodology.convergence_criterion: 7-day rolling MAPE within ±5pp of day-90 value

naive_costs.description: National average baseline — unacceptably high error leads to overstock and stockout losses

champion_costs.description: Bayesian blended champion — analog prior with live Lucknow adaptation

savings.description: Cost avoided through champion model over 90-day holdout window

external_signals.description: Daily temperature, rainfall, humidity and climate zone scores for 28 tier-1/2 cities
City-level CPI, fuel price index, disposable income proxy from RBI and census data
Store-level footfall scores derived from Google Mobility and OpenStreetMap catchment analysis
National and state-level festival dates, public holiday flags and category-specific uplift multipliers
Scraped price and promo data from 6 rival retail chains across 42 target micro-markets
City/district master with tier, climate zone, analog similarity pre-computed for all 9 candidate cities
Category-level demand sensitivity to weather patterns — pre-aggregated from silver.ext_weather
City × category × festival demand uplift index derived from 5 years of analog city sales
Category elasticity w.r.t. CPI, fuel prices and income proxies — monthly rolling window
Store format × category demand baseline index calibrated to analog city sales history
79 engineered features across weather, festival, macro and mobility signals for all 42 SKUs × 90 holdout days

weather_signal_inputs.description: Derived extreme event flag (heatwave/heavy rain/cold snap)
